The structure of Fe8Ni4W4 (reduced formula Fe2NiW) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Pnma (No. 143), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed across four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Fe centers with 11 geometric neighbors (3 Fe, 5 Ni, 3 W), while Ni and W each have 9 neighbors, and the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Fe 11-vertex polyhedra, with corner- and face-sharing between Ni and W 9-vertex polyhedra.
